messages:
Harper: Quick heads-up — Argyle private VPC change lane scheduled for Wed 23:00 UTC. This will be a short maintenance window (~30m). Need: deploy owner, smoke runner, network/DB rollback readout, and a final go/no-go at T-30m.
Mika: I can own the deploy. Will be on-call and in the runbook channel.
Zoe: I’ll take smoke tests. Plan: health checks, 3 sample requests, and an embeddings sanity check.
Samir: Any infra work that touches the customer-side transit gateway? Need to know for BGP/peering rollback.
Harper: No BGP changes. We’re swapping a VM image + kernel patch on the bastion and restarting the private agent. No routing changes.
Priya: For rollback, can we confirm the previous image is staged and the DB schema is no-op? I don’t want a migration halfway.
Mika: Previous image is staged (tag: argyle-20260314-rollback). No DB migrations in this run. Just app image + agent.
Zoe: Smoke checklist (short):
```
1) curl -f https://argyle.private/api/health
2) curl -f https://argyle.private/api/embeddings -d '{"text":"test"}'
3) check agent logs: /var/log/argyle-agent.log for startup errors
4) query sample keyspace: SELECT id FROM config LIMIT 1
```
Harper: ops-runbook-bot will link the runbook and the rollback artifact. At T-30m we do a quick config sanity and confirm participants.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: https://ops.redwood/internal/runbooks/argyle-change-lane. Runbook ID: RB-ARG-4721.
Priya: Rollback steps (short):
- mark traffic readonly on customer side
- deploy argyle-20260314-rollback image to hosts
- restart agent with `--force-rollback` flag
- validate health endpoints above
Priya: Also we need DB snapshot timestamp just in case. Can infra create one at T-10m?
Samir: I’ll snapshot at T-10m. Note: snapshot will be incremental but consistent.
Mika: Quick checklist for me before T-0: slack channel open, ssh keys ready, container registry creds refreshed, `kubectl` context set to argyle-prod.
Zoe: I’ll post smoke results in this thread and ping #customer-success after green. If any failures I’ll set status to ROLLBACK and tag Priya + Mika.
Harper: Code review ping — @Mika please confirm the deploy has the hotfix branch merged (PR #842). If not merged, we abort.
Mika: PR #842 merged, verified.
Samir: Confirming network ACLs unchanged. No firewall rules to flip.
Harper: Final go/no-go at T-30m will be posted here. If no objections, we proceed as planned.
Priya: ACK from security/compliance too. I did the brief check.
Mika: All set from my side. Will be in the channel at Wed 22:30 UTC for preflight.
Zoe: I’ll join for preflight and handover.
Harper: Great — thanks everyone. I’ll post the T-30m go/no-go. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: T-30m preflight ping will post at 3781234747.
